name: image2ascii-studio-web
description: Image to ASCII art in the browser: live preview, animated SVG and PNG export

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p image2ascii-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/image2ascii_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
